name: Accelerate Club RVCE
description: Established in 2022, the Accelerate Club is the premier computing club of RVCE's Computer Science & Engineering Department. Founded with a vision to create a dynamic platform for aspiring technologists, we have rapidly evolved into a catalyst for innovation and learning in the ever-expanding digital landscape.
